name: Bark
tagline: Transformer-based local text-to-audio model capable of realistic speech, laughter, sighs, and sound effects.
real_test_summary: Tested generating multi-language voice clips and non-speech audio cues offline via Python. Produces expressive intonation and natural pauses without cloud API keys, though generation is slower than lightweight TTS engines.
pros: Generates expressive speech along with laughter, hesitation, and nonverbal cues
Permissive MIT license allows commercial and offline local usage
Supports multiple languages out of the box without voice-specific training
cons: Slower inference speed than lightweight engines like Piper, especially on CPU
Output voice consistency can vary across longer multi-sentence generations
